# ailog

> A local, searchable log of every AI prompt. ailog captures every prompt and response automatically across Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and opencode — tagged with project, git branch, tool, model, and token usage, and kept locally in SQLite + FTS5. No cloud, no telemetry.

ailog is open source (thesatellite-ai/ai-logger-go). Everything runs locally; nothing is sent to the cloud.

- [README](https://github.com/thesatellite-ai/ai-logger-go/blob/main/README.md): overview, install, usage

- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/thesatellite-ai/ai-logger-go/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history

## Install
- Script (macOS/Linux): `curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thesatellite-ai/ai-logger-go/main/install.sh | sh`
- Releases: https://github.com/thesatellite-ai/ai-logger-go/releases
